description: This file defines a React component named 'Footer' that functions as the application's footer bar. It manages UI elements related to user account, settings, updates, sync status, offline mode, and various application events, interacting with application state and external services.

classes.name: Footer
classes.description: A React component representing the application's footer, responsible for displaying status indicators, user account controls, update notifications, sync status, and handling related events.

methods.name: reloadUpgradeStatus
methods.description: Checks for security updates and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Initializes the component on application launch, including reloading passcode status, user info, and upgrade status.

methods.name: reloadUser
methods.description: Reloads user information from the application instance.

methods.name: reloadPasscodeStatus
methods.description: Checks if the application has a passcode enabled and updates state.

methods.name: onAppKeyChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the application key, reloading passcode status.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Handles various application events such as sync status changes, out-of-sync state, and user sign-in/sign-out.

methods.name: updateSyncStatus
methods.description: Updates the UI based on current sync status, including download/upload progress.

methods.name: updateLocalDataStatus
methods.description: Updates status message related to local data loading or decryption progress.

methods.name: updateOfflineStatus
methods.description: Sets the offline state based on application connectivity.

methods.name: findErrors
methods.description: Checks and updates error states related to synchronization.

methods.name: securityUpdateClickHandler
methods.description: Handles user clicking to initiate a security protocol upgrade after confirmation.

methods.name: accountMenuClickHandler
methods.description: Toggles the account menu display.

methods.name: quickSettingsClickHandler
methods.description: Toggles the quick settings menu.

methods.name: syncResolutionClickHandler
methods.description: Toggles the sync resolution options menu.

methods.name: closeAccountMenu
methods.description: Closes the account menu and resets its pane.

methods.name: lockClickHandler
methods.description: Locks the application.

methods.name: onNewUpdateAvailable
methods.description: Sets state to show a notification about a new app update.

methods.name: newUpdateClickHandler
methods.description: Handles user clicking on the new update notification.

methods.name: betaMessageClickHandler
methods.description: Shows an alert dialog about beta version usage.

methods.name: clickOutsideAccountMenu
methods.description: Closes the account menu when clicking outside.

methods.name: clickOutsideQuickSettingsMenu
methods.description: Closes the quick settings menu when clicking outside.

methods.name: openPreferences
methods.description: Opens the preferences dialog, optionally showing the 'What's New' pane.
